jamie: Heads-up — CI is red on canary image build (ci/build-image#4821). Push to our registry is failing after a tiny Dockerfile tweak. Getting chunked EOFs during blob upload. Logs pasted below.

ci-bot: build #4821 failed — push step returned 503/EOF (retrying disabled by pipeline).

jamie: ```
INFO[0000] Pushing blob sha256:abcd1234...
INFO[0001] Uploading chunk 16/16
ERROR[0001] upload failed: unexpected EOF from registry: write tcp 10.0.0.5:42311->34.120.12.45:443: write: connection reset by peer
```

sara: @jamie did we rotate registry creds recently? or any rate-limit rules hit?

jamie: No creds rotation. Last successful push was from same pipeline 2 hours ago. I checked registry audit, no auth errors. Lots of repeated EOFs in the same blob chunk. Job uses kaniko with layer caching enabled.

micah: Could be a corrupted cache entry or flaky network on registry. Quick check: can you rerun the job with cache disabled to rule out cache corruption? `--cache=false` for kaniko. Also try `--single-snapshot` if using buildkit.

jamie: Starting rerun with cache off now. Command I used: `executor/kaniko:latest --context ${GIT_CONTEXT} --dockerfile Dockerfile --destination us.gcr.io/redwood/canary:${GIT_SHA} --cache=false`

ci-bot: rerun triggered for build #4821-rerun (user: jamie).

jamie: Rerun finished — push succeeded. No EOFs. So cache seems implicated.

micah: OK looks like stale/garbled cache layer causing upload to choke. Options: invalidate cache on CI when Dockerfile layer layout changes, or bump cache key. For kaniko we can add a build arg like `--cache-repo <repo>` or periodically prune.

jamie: I'll open a small PR to update the pipeline to run with `--cache-repo` set per-branch and add a cache-invalidate step when Dockerfile changes. Also adding a retry wrapper around the push step.

sara: Sounds good. @micah can you add a p0?jk — just kidding. Low severity but recurring flakiness would be annoying. Please tag me on the PR for rollout. :thumbsup:

micah: Also note this pattern can happen with large single-layer changes; consider splitting big COPYs to smaller layers if feasible.

jamie: Will do. Opening PR now and dropping a note in the pipeline config. Filing a short postmortem if we see more than 2 flaps in 24h. cc @sara

ci-bot: build #4821-rerun archived (success).
